evaluator: M3 exactly as Phase 1.14 (refit on revealed prefix at every budget, L=100)
control: M3 probability margin (Phase 1.14 P1); harness gate: 50/50 dev runs bit-identical q20 AULC
information_guard: policies receive masked label/depth arrays; unqueried/test labels, depths and B1 are never reachable

development_selection_rule.scope: any number of policies and refinements may be screened, on development repeats only
development_selection_rule.finalists: at most 2, ranked by development paired delta q20 AULC 16-80 vs margin
eligibility: B40 q20 KH recall not below margin by more than 0.03

confirmation_rule.data: confirmation repeats 11-20 (50 runs), untouched until finalists are frozen
confirmation_rule.inference: 10 paired repeat blocks; 10,000-draw repeat-block bootstrap; sign-flip permutation; Holm over finalists x {16-80, 16-40}
CONFIRMED_if: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and bootstrap 95% CI > 0 on at least one of the two windows
the other window has a non-negative point estimate
guardrails: B40 q20 KH recall drop <= 0.03 and B80 full81 accuracy drop <= 0.01
confirmation_rule.otherwise: NOT_CONFIRMED - reported as such, development numbers labelled as development

reporting: after confirmation, finalists are also run on all 100 runs for thesis-comparable numbers, labelled as including development repeats
